const fail = () => { throw new Error("x"); };
function f(): number { return fail(); }
const fail2 = function () { throw new Error("x"); };
function g(): string { return fail2(); }
function decl() { throw new Error("x"); }
function h(): number { return decl(); }
const o = { m() { throw new Error("x"); } };
function k(): number { return o.m(); }
class C { m() { throw new Error("x"); } }
function p(): number { return new C().m(); }
const loop = () => { while (true) {} };
const n: never = loop();
console.log(typeof f, typeof g, typeof k);
